"It's all fun and games until you have to plug an ID into a keyboard," Wendell said. We talk about ID verification law and its intrusiveness for internet usage, free speech, and the intersection with technology. Services like VPNs may be on the chopping block, following router bands and control and ID verification requirements for website usage. We also talk about awareness of what's happening and getting involved at hearings and townhalls to fight back at local levels.

Find Wendell here: https://www.youtube.com/c/level1techs
